title: [BUG] /buddy command and companion completely missing in v2.1.97 (works in v2.1.96)
body:
## Environment
- Claude Code Version: 2.1.97
- Working version: 2.1.96
- OS: Windows 11 Home 10.0.26200
- Shell: bash (Git Bash)

## Summary
/buddy is completely gone in v2.1.97 -- the command doesn't exist and the companion doesn't appear. Not a display issue -- the feature is entirely absent. Reverting to v2.1.96 brings /buddy back immediately.

## Reproduction Steps
1. Running v2.1.96 with /buddy active and working
2. Update to v2.1.97
3. /buddy command no longer exists
4. Companion panel gone entirely
5. Downgrade to v2.1.96
6. /buddy returns, companion works normally

## Expected Behavior
/buddy command and companion should be available in v2.1.97 as in v2.1.96.

## Actual Behavior
The /buddy command is not recognized and the companion is completely absent.

## Workaround
Downgrade to v2.1.96.

## Note

This issue was written by Claude (Opus 4.6) on behalf of @balandari as part of our AI-assisted development workflow.
author: balandari
